Alex (CS): Weekly Starlane health check — focusing cache+batching effectiveness. Quick snapshot: hit rate 41%, avg batch size 3.8, cost per 1k tokens $0.83, p95 latency 210ms, error rate 0.12%.
Maria (Success): thanks Alex. Did hit rate dip after the onboarding spike last week?
Alex (CS): yes — we saw a drop from 68% to 41% after the onboarding surge on Mon. Prefetch cohort for new orgs not warmed.
Ryan (SE): looks like their requests have a lot of short unique prefixes, so cache reuse low. Session length up too -> KV cache churn.
Priya (Solutions): can we add a lightweight warm-up for new tenants? maybe a cheap prefill on first 1k users. What's the cost delta?
Alex (CS): rough calc: prefill of top 200 templates ~+$120/week but should boost hit rate to ~62% per our sim. Net token cost down overall.
Maria (Success): include in the renewal playbook? this would help their cost concerns.
Ryan (SE): posted a quick patch to batching config in staging. snippet: ```json
{"max_batch_size":8, "batch_timeout_ms":12, "kv_cache_ttl_sec":7200, "prefix_cache_enabled":true}
```
Priya (Solutions): nice. Any regressions on p95 when increasing batch size?
Ryan (SE): p95 stayed within 10% when we bumped to 8 in staging for similar traffic. p50 improved. Also lowered per-token encode overhead.
ops-bot: Deploy started: staging/batching-config -> v2026-03-19T14:33 (id: deploy-6621).
Alex (CS): plan for prod: enable prefix_cache + batch_size=6, monitor 24h, then consider 8 if no regressions. Will also run a targeted prefill experiment for the new-tenant cohort.
Maria (Success): action items: Alex to run prefill cost sim and draft note for Starlane; Priya to outline warm-up play for renewal deck; Ryan to roll prod config and add tracing hook for KV churn.
Alex (CS): noted. I'll have the sim and draft ready by Thu EOD.
Priya (Solutions): I'll add a one-pager for the renewal call.
Ryan (SE): rolling prod change now, will ping when live.
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: production/batching-config -> v2026-03-19T15:02 (id: deploy-6622).
Maria (Success): thanks everyone — post results next check-in, flagged renewal risk as "monitoring" until we see hit-rate back above 55%. :eyes: 
Alex (CS): will report metrics snapshot in next weekly.
Priya (Solutions): adding recommended messaging for Starlane onboarding email to encourage reuse of canonical prompts.
Ryan (SE): adding short logging diff to capture prefix hit/miss distribution (will keep <100MB/day).
Alex (CS): closing thread for now.
